Northstar Analytics builds demand-forecasting models for retail chains.
Full-time, USD 5000–6500/month, async team, any time zone.

You will:
• train and evaluate forecasting and NLP models (PyTorch, scikit-learn)

You have 4+ years in data science, strong statistics, Python, SQL, MLflow.
